announcement.title: 0.4.20 — tagging kicks, bans and warns is fixed
announcement.message:
Sorry: in 0.4.19, tagging moderation events from Discord was broken. Searching for tags after clicking Edit tags was refused for everyone who isn't a server admin.

0.4.20 fixes it with no setup needed:
• Edit tags is back to the familiar dropdowns of every tag with descriptions.
• New /tag add and /tag remove, used inside a moderation thread, search every tag as you type.
• If your role can post in the moderation thread, you can tag. Instance hosts who warn and kick can now tag too.
• Timed ban and group join-request buttons also work for moderators by default now.

Can't update yet? A server admin can unlock tag search on 0.4.19 by running these once (use your moderator role):
/scarlet-discord-permissions set target:@Moderators type:Modal Submit name:tag-search value:Allow
/scarlet-discord-permissions set target:@Moderators type:String Select name:select-tags-search value:Allow

Full details are in the 0.4.20 release notes.
